integrity: The universal statement is proved symbolically from the Jacobian ideal and binary-edge restrictions. The included finite-field checker is an exact witness and consistency check, not evidence for universality by enumeration.
limitations: The coefficient criterion is for the marked tetrahedral normal form and is not an intrinsic projective classification after the marking is forgotten.
The proof is characteristic-two specific and does not classify the individual boundary strata where one or more coefficients vanish.
An equivalent calculation could exist in classical or unindexed literature under different terminology.
title: Exact 12-node chamber for the tetrahedral square-quartic family in characteristic two
